newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Goldlion denies eyeing Giordano stake.
newsitem.headline: Goldlion denies eyeing Giordano stake.

text.p: Men's clothing maker and retailer Goldlion Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was not in talks to buy stake in Giordano International Ltd.
"The company wishes to clarify that there is no negotiation nor appointment of financial adviser for the acquisition of shares in Giordano International Ltd," Goldlion said.
Goldlion said it made the statement in respect of a local media report saying the company has appointed a financial adviser for acquisition of shares in the casual apparel retailer.
Giordano shares closed Monday HK$0.05 up at HK$4.70. Goldlion shares ended HK$0.05 higher at HK$6.45.
